function.name: LSP
function.description: Find where a symbol at a given file position is defined. Input line and character are one-based UTF-16; returned ranges are zero-based. Add 1 to each returned coordinate before reusing it as input.

filePath.description: Absolute path, or a path relative to the agent's current working directory.

character.description: 1-based character offset in UTF-16 code units (same as character count for ASCII).
